description: This Java class 'OnStopHandler' encapsulates a consumer for handling 'StoppedTimer' instances when a timer stops. It provides a constructor to register the consumer and a method to invoke with a 'StoppedTimer' object.

classes.name: OnStopHandler
classes.description: A class that handles the event of a timer stopping by invoking a registered consumer with a 'StoppedTimer' object.

methods.name: OnStopHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with a consumer to be invoked when a timer stops.

methods.name: handleStoppedTimer
methods.description: Method that accepts a 'StoppedTimer' object and passes it to the registered consumer.
